title: Deed
description: Deed contract normalized from the DocuBricks Real estate library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-real-estate-deed
  title: Deed
  description: Deed contract normalized from the DocuBricks Real estate library.
  version: real_estate_deed_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: real_estate/deed
    sourcePath: Schemas/real_estate/deed
    sourceVersion: real_estate_deed_v1
    sourceDigest: cf7d40284d92d5b9a2dc367e7b65e9f06c22ddb98eb1de0b2da6cdfd292e79e2
spec:
  documentType: deed
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - deed-date
        - recording-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - county
        - deed-type
        - recording-number
        - state
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - consideration-amount
        - transfer-tax-amount
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - grantee-names
        - grantor-names
        - notary-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - legal-description
        - property-address
  fields:
    - id: deed-date
      name: deed_date
      label: Deed Date
      description: Date of deed.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/deed_date
    - id: deed-type
      name: deed_type
      label: Deed Type
      description: Warranty deed, special warranty deed, quitclaim deed, grant deed, or other type.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/deed_type
    - id: grantor-names
      name: grantor_names
      label: Grantor Names
      description: Grantor names.
      dataType: array
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/grantor_names
    - id: grantee-names
      name: grantee_names
      label: Grantee Names
      description: Grantee names.
      dataType: array
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/grantee_names
    - id: property-address
      name: property_address
      label: Property Address
      description: Property address.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/property_address
    - id: legal-description
      name: legal_description
      label: Legal Description
      description: Legal description of conveyed property.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/legal_description
    - id: consideration-amount
      name: consideration_amount
      label: Consideration Amount
      description: Stated consideration amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/consideration_amount
    - id: county
      name: county
      label: County
      description: County of property or recording.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/county
    - id: state
      name: state
      label: State
      description: State of property or recording.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/state
    - id: recording-date
      name: recording_date
      label: Recording Date
      description: Recording date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/recording_date
    - id: recording-number
      name: recording_number
      label: Recording Number
      description: Instrument, book/page, reception, or recording number.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/recording_number
    - id: notary-name
      name: notary_name
      label: Notary Name
      description: Notary name.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/notary_name
    - id: transfer-tax-amount
      name: transfer_tax_amount
      label: Transfer Tax Amount
      description: Transfer tax or documentary stamp amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/transfer_tax_amount
  validationRules:
    - id: deed-date-present
      severity: error
      description: deed_date is required for Deed extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: deed_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: deed_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: deed_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(deed_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: deed-type-present
      severity: error
      description: deed_type is required for Deed extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: deed_type
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: deed_type
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: deed_type IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(deed_type)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: grantor-names-present
      severity: error
      description: grantor_names is required for Deed extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: grantor_names
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: grantor_names
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: grantor_names IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(grantor_names) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: grantee-names-present
      severity: error
      description: grantee_names is required for Deed extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: grantee_names
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: grantee_names
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: grantee_names IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(grantee_names) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: legal-description-present
      severity: error
      description: legal_description is required for Deed extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: legal_description
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: legal_description
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: legal_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(legal_description)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: consideration-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: consideration_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: consideration_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: consideration_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: consideration_amount IS NULL OR consideration_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: transfer-tax-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: transfer_tax_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: transfer_tax_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: transfer_tax_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: transfer_tax_amount IS NULL OR transfer_tax_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      deed_type:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Deed workflow.
      grantor_names:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Deed workflow.
      grantee_names:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Deed workflow.
      legal_description:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Deed workflow.
      recording_number:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: High-impact field for Deed workflow.
      deed_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Deed workflow.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Deed documents combine real estate parties, property, title, lease, financial, and operating context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      deed_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of deed.
        format: date
      deed_type:
        type: string
        description: Warranty deed, special warranty deed, quitclaim deed, grant deed, or other type.
      grantor_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Grantor names.
      grantee_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Grantee names.
      property_address:
        type: string
        description: Property address.
      legal_description:
        type: string
        description: Legal description of conveyed property.
      consideration_amount:
        type: number
        description: Stated consideration amount.
      county:
        type: string
        description: County of property or recording.
      state:
        type: string
        description: State of property or recording.
      recording_date:
        type: date
        description: Recording date.
        format: date
      recording_number:
        type: string
        description: Instrument, book/page, reception, or recording number.
      notary_name:
        type: string
        description: Notary name.
      transfer_tax_amount:
        type: number
        description: Transfer tax or documentary stamp amount.
    required:
      - deed_date
      - deed_type
      - grantor_names
      - grantee_names
      - legal_description
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: real_estate_transactions
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - deed_date
          - deed_type
          - grantor_names
          - grantee_names
          - legal_description
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
